subject: Datadog x Redwood: OTLP ingestion + marketplace onboarding sync

Cc: Partnerships Team <partnerships@datadoghq.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Datadog x Redwood — OTLP ingestion + marketplace listing

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for taking the intro last week. Datadog partners team is excited about a tighter integration for OTLP-forwarded telemetry from Redwood-hosted runtimes, plus a co-listed Marketplace entry to drive joint demand.

High-level ask: can we validate OTLP ingestion profiles (headers, resource attributes), agree on a marketplace bundle (billing/contract), and confirm a go-to-market timeline for a preview listing?

Suggested attendees: Partnerships, Marketplace ops, and an infra engineer who owns OTLP compatibility.

Proposed time: Wed Jun 10, 10:00–11:00 PT — does that work?

Attached: sample OTLP payloads we see in pilot.

Appreciate it —
Ethan
Partnerships, Datadog

Subject: Re: Datadog x Redwood — OTLP ingestion + marketplace listing

Thanks Ethan — this is high priority for our partnerships slate. Wed 10:00 PT works for our side. I'll loop in our marketplace PM (Vanessa) and technical lead (Jonas).

Ahead of the call, I want to confirm two things so we can come prepared:
- A short checklist of OTLP attributes you need validated (resource keys, attribute naming conventions, proto/OTLP versions).
- The desired contract/settlement model for the Marketplace listing (referral, co-sell revenue split, or lead-gen).

Please share any example payloads or SLOs you want us to test.

Best,

Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Datadog x Redwood — OTLP ingestion + marketplace listing

Hi all —

Quick tech pre-read from our side (we'll run through these on Wed):
1) OTLP versions: Redwood's runtime currently emits OTLP v0.14 and v1.0 over gRPC; we can enable proto-level field mapping for the attributes you request.
2) Resource attributes: confirm whether you prefer datadog.service, service.name, and a custom redwood.instance_id tag. We can add a config flag for customers.
3) Sampling / batching: we will forward both sampled spans and aggregated metrics; want to align on sampling passthrough semantics.
4) Authentication: we support OTLP over mTLS and token-based headers — which does Datadog marketplace prefer for partner onboarding?

Attachment: redwood-datadog-otlp-checklist.pdf (checklist + mapping table)

I'll prepare a short demo of a synthetic firehose to show ingestion and tag mapping.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Partnerships Team <partnerships@datadoghq.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Datadog x Redwood — OTLP ingestion + marketplace listing

On Wed, 9 Jun 2026 08:23:00 -0700 Jonas Weber wrote:
> Hi all —
> 
> Quick tech pre-read from our side (we'll run through these on Wed):
> 1) OTLP versions: Redwood's runtime currently emits OTLP v0.14 and v1.0 over gRPC; we can enable proto-level field mapping for the attributes you request.
> 2) Resource attributes: confirm whether you prefer datadog.service, service.name, and a custom redwood.instance_id tag. We can add a config flag for customers.
> 3) Sampling / batching: we will forward both sampled spans and aggregated metrics; want to align on sampling passthrough semantics.
> 4) Authentication: we support OTLP over mTLS and token-based headers — which does Datadog marketplace prefer for partner onboarding?

Thanks Jonas — this is great context. A few clarifications from our Marketplace Ops and ingestion teams: 
- We prefer OTLP v1.0 where possible, but can accept v0.14 with mapping rules.
- For tags, Datadog will canonicalize service.* to datadog.service; adding redwood.instance_id is helpful for multi-tenant attribution.
- Authentication: token headers (x-datadog-api-key partner token) are preferred for the Marketplace preview; mTLS for production SLA customers.

Marketplace ops also asked for a short partner agreement draft (billing model and landing page content). I've attached a draft term sheet; please review and share legal feedback.

Also, quick ask: can Redwood provide a 30-day preview listing (non-billable) so we can collect usage and co-marketing assets?

Cheers,
Ethan

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Liu <ethan.liu@datadoghq.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

- I'll sync with our legal and partnerships to review the marketplace term sheet and get back with redlines by Fri Jun 18. (owner: naomi.feldman)

Attachments: marketplace-agreement-draft.docx, arch-otlp-ingest-diagram.png

Also linking the HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/RDW-PP-2026-045 — I updated the expected pilot start date to Jun 21.

If you want to run an initial non-billable preview earlier, Jonas can spin up a short-lived ingest endpoint; ping us with a target tenant id and we'll prioritize.

Best,
